ideas.pitch: publish voice assets encoding fluidity metrics of dance sequences for analytics and coaching.
ideas.quantumRationale: Realtime scribe is the right primitive for fluidity measurement: the user speaks the work into existence and Dance & Choreography needs the captions to land as the words land.

ideas.title: ShadowStep Registry
ideas.pitch: Catalog silent or lip-synced dance movements as voice assets for licensing and crediting.
ideas.quantumRationale: Realtime scribe is the right primitive for silent movement catalog: the user speaks the work into existence and Dance & Choreography needs the captions to land as the words land.

ideas.title: LeapChain audio logs
ideas.pitch: publish voice assets of signature leaps to prove originality and enable commercial licensing.
ideas.quantumRationale: Realtime scribe is the right primitive for leaps and jumps: the user speaks the work into existence and Dance & Choreography needs the captions to land as the words land.
